observed: Current sight starts the warning before firing
Moving shots reduce robot health to disabled
Unavailable pickup and weapon controls disappear after death
Reset restores health and weapon controls
Narrow controls fit without horizontal overflow

recording.note: Original browser recording copied without retiming. Video only; browser audio has separate signal measurements. Standard keyboard events control the character.

audio.method: Diagnostic page installs a passive AnalyserNode before the unchanged application modules. It explicitly suspends the real output context. A trusted keyboard event resumes it through the application helper. No simulation state is edited.

limitations: The qualified hover policy does not pursue or search for the robot
Weapon timing is a deterministic local game profile, not measured ARC parity
The follow camera can lose a nearby drone below the view
Robot hit reactions and trained humanoid combat remain pending
Native window execution, actual mobile touch input, and hardware speakers remain unverified
Existing WebGL warnings and the full-project personal Rust lint backlog remain
